name: @art-pollinator/transport-http
description: TransportPort implementation over HTTP (issue #43, pulled forward from Phase 2): HttpTransportServer (the side that listens — realistically a stationary Wi-Fi node, Phase 2) and HttpTransportClient (the side that dials out — usable from clients/mobile, including the web build, since it only ever uses fetch). Carries the real wire-protocol messages from @art-pollinator/core's protocol/* unchanged.
